headline: Papathanasis: Package for the TIF Over 1 Billion Euros – “There Will Be No Recession” After the Recovery Fund
summary: Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Papathanasis said a package of over €1 billion will be presented at the Thessaloniki International Fair. Measures will focus on the middle class, pensioners and families, with final decisions resting with the prime minister.
why: Fiscal support packages affect Greek government spending, deficit targets and government bond investors.
